mentions.name: Puzzleship
mentions.description: This website offers free daily puzzles with the archives behind a paywall. It currently includes Logic Grid Puzzles, Zebra Puzzles, and a dozen Solitaire variations, and features a custom Logic Grid Puzzle generator algorithm for constructing the puzzles.
mentions.source_excerpt: Puzzleship - a free daily puzzles website with the archives paywalled. Right now it has Logic Grid Puzzles, Zebra Puzzles and a dozen of Solitaire variations. I'm pretty proud of the LGP generator algorithm and some experienced players also liked the way the puzzles are constructed.
